metric_definitions.active_support_size: Count of sites with tau above baseline excess threshold.
metric_definitions.centroid_drift: Manhattan drift of active centroid from initial to final.
metric_definitions.discrete_laplacian_energy_proxy: Sum of squared discrete Laplacian proxy values.
metric_definitions.finite_speed_violation_count: Steps where active support grew beyond one-hop envelope.
metric_definitions.localization_score: Active localization ratio at final step.
metric_definitions.oscillation_score: Normalized sign-change score of profile L1 deltas.
metric_definitions.propagation_radius: Max Manhattan radius of active support from centroid.
metric_definitions.recurrence_score: Similarity of final profile to earliest nontrivial step.
metric_definitions.spreading_score: Normalized increase in active support size.
metric_definitions.support_centroid: Active-excess weighted centroid on count lattice.
metric_definitions.tau_gradient_l1: Sum of gradient magnitudes over interior/boundary sites.
metric_definitions.tau_variance: Variance of tau values across lattice sites.
metric_definitions.total_tau: Sum of tau over all lattice sites (not physical energy).
metric_definitions.total_tau_change: Final minus initial total tau (conservation diagnostic).
